(C2) rigidification, first landing: the rigidification calculus and the sheafification unit. The section-of-a-point retraction of the curve product with its naturality; rigidified classes (pullback along the section trivial — a Prop, no stored data) stable under base change; Kleiman lm:idn both ways — every relative Picard class has a rigidified representative (the twist M ⋅ (p^* σ^* M)⁻¹) and rigidified representatives of equal classes are equal ON THE NOSE; the rigidified mirror of the descent-class congruence, UNCONDITIONAL: a rigidified representative of a descent class pulls back equally along Spec of any two algebra maps, hence its descent equation holds as an honest Čech-Picard equality on the double tensor — the entry point for the effectivity campaign; and the lm:aut ring heart (σ-pullback of global unit sections is bijective). Plus the sheafification unit picEtUnit : relPicFunctor ⟶ picEtFunctor in full (components instance-free, affine face = the plus unit, naturality through the unique-pullback-value API), and fromSpecAffine plumbing. Wave 2b, the χ-ledger's divisor-sheaf wave: residue-degree finiteness and positivity at closed points (κ(x) as the chart quotient via localization transport and Jacobson finiteness — the induction gate); principal divisors (the integer-valued order homomorphism on units of the function field with classical sign, divOf with its multiplicativity and finite support via the basic-open unit-germ argument; QuasiCompact added to the hypotheses, documented — finite type alone does not give a Noetherian space); the divisor sheaf O(D) by pole bounds with monotone inclusions and the zero-divisor comparison divisorSheafZeroIso to the structure module sheaf (germ-at-the-generic-point componentwise, surjectivity by the DVR pole-bound stalk lemma and structure-sheaf gluing); and the dévissage tower through S2 — point lattices, the jump module, the projection to the skyscraper — with the short complex, its composition vanishing and the mono leg (S3 partial). RiemannRoch/ResidueDegree, PrincipalDivisor, DivisorSheaf, DivisorSheafZero, Devissage; root build 8664 jobs, keystones axiom-clean. Frontier: the dévissage epi/exactness, the jump-dimension identity, then chi and Riemann-Roch-lite

Wave 2b, the dévissage short-exact sequence and the jump dimension: the sequence 0 → O(D−x) → O(D) → skyscraper_x(jump) → 0 is short exact (devissageSES_shortExact — epi via local surjectivity of the projection, excising the finite bad locus and lifting a jump-class representative; middle exactness sectionwise through the pole-lattice/jumpProj equivalence, transported to the sheaf level by limit-reflection), and the jump module is the residue field as a K-space so its dimension is the residue degree (finrank_jumpModule via the uniformizer-shift isomorphism O(D)_x/O(D−x)_x ≅ κ(x) and the first isomorphism theorem). Plus the divisor-sheaf multiplication equivalence mulEquivDivisorSheaf toward the principal-divisor degree identity. G7 closed and G8's multiplication piece landed.
